hero.title: Who is SPRINT?
hero.description: SPRINT is a future-ready training hub in Hazaribagh, Jharkhand that bridges the gap between academic learning and industry execution through hands-on programs in emerging technologies.

story.heading: Our Story
story.subtitle: Why SPRINT was established
paragraphs: SPRINT was born from a simple observation: thousands of talented students graduate every year, yet most are not ready for the demands of industry. Classrooms teach theory, while companies hire for execution — and that gap keeps talent out of the workforce.

We founded SPRINT in Hazaribagh with one clear promise — make learners job-ready by training them the way the industry actually works. Every SPRINT program is built around real projects, production tooling and the discipline of shipping working software.
Today, SPRINT brings together industry practitioners, academics and motivated learners under one roof to close the skills gap in AI/ML, Cloud Computing and DevOps — one engineer at a time.

mission.statement: To make every learner job-ready by delivering industry-aligned, hands-on training in emerging technologies through production-grade practice, mentorship and disciplined execution.

industry.heading: Industry & Academic Connection
industry.subtitle: Closing the skills gap between classrooms and careers
paragraphs: Colleges teach fundamentals; companies hire for delivery. This disconnect — the academic–industry skill gap — is exactly what SPRINT exists to close.
SPRINT programs are co-designed with working practitioners and delivered in the tools of industry. You learn by building what the market needs today, guided by people who ship it for a living.
industry.approach: Our approach is simple: smaller cohorts, real projects, production tooling, and relentless practice until execution becomes second nature.
